Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
can a retainer be damaged by environmental damage like carrion crows or
murder of crows (at long range of course) ?

after reading [6.4.7.] i'd say no, the retainer can only be damaged by
ranged strikes at long range. and special cards like body of sun and weather
control.

pallando
